posts.text: Donald Trump wants to start one war, and then another war, and then another war. The American people are not looking for wars around the world; we are looking for lower prices here at home.

If we want to win in 2026 and 2028, Democrats need to take on the big fights.

Bring costs down.

End the corruption.

End the war in Iran.

Make life easier for working Americans.

No more hand-waving.

It's time to get serious.

Trump used the threat of a lawsuit against his own government to pressure nearly $2 billion out of the U.S. Treasury.

No jury decided this.

No judge approved it.

Congress never voted on it.

But your taxpayer dollars funded it.
time.com/article/2026/05/27/…

AI was built on your creativity, your tax dollars, and your electric grid.

The profits shouldn't only flow to billionaires.

It's time to tax AI and invest in people.

Donald Trump is rewriting the rules for his own benefit, and Republicans in Congress just let it happen.

Spineless doesn't begin to cover it.

We took an oath to the Constitution, not to Donald Trump.

Americans: We want to be able to afford health care, groceries, and gas.

Trump: Let me build a UFC fighting cage outside the White House.


Pop Crave (@PopCrave)

New photo of the UFC arena construction at the White House.





— https://nitter.net/PopCrave/status/2059422710757830683#m
Trump is more focused on trading corporate stocks than lowering the price of gas and groceries.

Trump’s government just gave him and his family immunity from tax prosecution. For life.

Which begs the question: What is Trump hiding in his taxes?

Video

I can’t believe I have to say this:

The President should not financially benefit from the very government he controls.

I’ve got a bill to stop Trump’s corruption.

Democrats should be talking about making child care more affordable every chance we get, going into the midterms and into 2028.

If we demonstrate how we'll actually make this care real for families—and actually fight for it—we can win.

Republicans want billions for ICE's unchecked terror—no oversight, no rules, no accountability.

I will continue to say NO.

That money could be used for:

✅ Schools & child care

✅ Healthcare

✅ Housing

✅ Jobs

Memorial Day is a special day in our family. All three of my brothers served—and I’m forever grateful they made it home safely.

To the service members who do not, we owe a debt that cannot be repaid.

No matter how you honor Memorial Day, I hope you have a meaningful day.
The President should be lowering costs, not trading stocks.

Trump sued his own IRS.

Settled with his own government.

Secured a $1.8 billion slush fund to siphon toward his allies.

Blocked the IRS audits against himself and his family. 

This is corruption in plain sight.

FOREVER BARRED.

That's the actual language that protects Trump and his family from ever having to answer for an audit of his taxes.

The corruption is staggering.
